result.title: Optimal Subgroup Discovery at Every Support Threshold
result.summary: Subgroup discovery aims to identify regions of the feature space where a target variable deviates from its marginal distribution. A fundamental challenge in this problem is the trade-off between a subgroup's deviation and its support: small subgroups can be highly deviating but statistically meaningless, while large ones cannot deviate much by construction. Existing methods tackle this challenge by collapsing the two into a single scalar quality measure, implicitly committing to one particular trade-off and making it difficult to recover the most deviating subgroup under a user-specified support constraint. We instead provide the first theoretical and structural characterization of optimal subgroups with maximum Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence under arbitrary support constraints. Under a partition-based generative model, where the feature space decomposes into regions of homogeneous conditional distributions of the target variable called atoms, we prove that every point on the deviation-support Pareto front is a union of whole atoms together with at most one fractional atom. This reduces an uncountable search to a finite combinatorial problem. Guided by this theory, we propose a simple two-step recipe: learn a homogeneous partition, then select atoms greedily. Across 19 benchmark datasets, it finds the most deviating subgroups at a range of support thresholds, and reliably improves subgroups returned by existing methods when applied as a post-processing step. These results empirically validate the sufficiency and necessity of our theoretical contributions.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究子群发现中偏离度与支持度的权衡，在分块生成模型下刻画任意支持约束下最大化 KL 散度的最优子群结构：帕累托前沿由若干完整 atom 至多再加一个分数 atom 构成，并据此提出「学同质划分再贪心选 atom」的两步方法，在 19 个数据集上验证。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「给定支持约束下最大化信息偏离」的可数化组合刻画，可能启发 LVR 中在可靠性与支撑约束下筛选视觉证据子集的表述，但属远域类比，可供核查是否真有可用线索。
